{{Infobox auto|Honey Bottle}}

'''Honey''', collected as a '''honey bottle''', is a raw [[ingredient]] whose [[intrinsic]] is {{EffectLink|Speed}}. The honey bottle itself is unchanged from vanilla; heated into [[Honey Ginger Tea|honey ginger tea]], fermented into [[mead]] or poured on [[Honied French Toast|honied French toast]], it grants Speed for {{Value|Honey Ginger Tea|duration|effect=Speed}}, {{Value|Mead|duration|effect=Speed}} and {{Value|Honied French Toast|duration|effect=Speed}} (Speed II).

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
A honey bottle is drunk as in vanilla and removes Poison. It doesn't heal, since it keeps the vanilla food values and the pack's healing comes from its own foods.

Picking up a honey bottle unlocks honey ginger tea, mead, [[Bubbling Mead|bubbling mead]], honied French toast and sugar. Honey bottles also go into [[Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal|apple cinnamon oatmeal]]. A honey bottle crafts into 3 [[sugar]], and 4 make a honey block; 4 [[molasses]] also make a honey block.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/sugar_from_honey_bottle.json}}</ref>
